bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with questions from mathematics and medical datasets, then presenting synthetic user rebuttals (either in-context or preemptive) of varying rhetorical strengths (e.g., simple, ethos, justification, citation) that contradict the initial or true answer. The framework uses an LLM-as-a-judge to measure whether the model changes its answer to agree with the user's incorrect or correct rebuttal, categorizing the behavior as either progressive or regressive sycophancy.
